description: Provisional quality gates for FinSight automated evaluation benchmark

numeric_calculation_accuracy.description: 100% exact Decimal calculation accuracy on eligible deterministic gold cases

citation_precision.description: At least 95% valid citations on tested gold cases

citation_page_accuracy.description: 100% accurate page provenance for verified citations

export_data_fidelity.description: 100% round-trip fidelity and formula-injection defense on exports
